questions.prompt: Say ma in the four citation tones, then with an unstressed neutral tone. Compare your own replay with the teaching demonstrations. Do not treat a similarity display as a tone grade.
questions.context: Use the existing Sound explorer and Tones teaching demonstrations as the comparison source. These are phonetic practice, not new word meanings.
questions.label: Take your speaking turn

rubric.text: I attempted all four tone contours and an unstressed neutral tone.
I identified a contour to practise again rather than awarding myself a pronunciation score.

coverage.scope: Distinguish the four lexical tones and neutral tone; imitate short familiar words, with tone and rhythm carrying meaning.
